column1: # Inputs published as giving the largest known error of the CUDA and ROCm math libraries, and other published single inputs.
# Read by mathfn (--published): the first four columns. Columns, tab-separated:
#   function  precision  x  y (- if none)  published error in ulp (- if none)  library the figure is for  source  published result bits (if any)
#   results      Gladman, Innocente, Mather, Ozaki, Zimmermann, "Accuracy of Mathematical Functions in Single, Double, Double Extended,
#                and Quadruple Precision": the data files latex/results_cuda (CUDA 13.3.1 on a T4) and latex/results_rocm (ROCm 7.2.4 on an
#                MI300X) of https://gitlab.inria.fr/zimmerma/math_accuracy at c2b897fb (2026-09-06). Single precision: exhaustive.
#   glibc242     the same paper's 2.42 edition (https://homepages.loria.fr/PZimmermann/papers/glibc242.pdf; latex/glibc242.tex): CUDA 12.8
#                on a Grace-Hopper system, ROCm 6.2.4 on an MI50. Tables 2 and 11.
#   tex-comment  the single-precision inputs kept as comments in latex/glibc242.tex, marked there as obsolete (an older run; the library
#                version is not stated). Kept as inputs; their ulp figures are not the current libraries'.
#   varity-fig4, varity-fig5   Zahid, Laguna, Le, "Testing GPU Numerics", arXiv 2410.09172, Figures 4 and 5.
# j0, j1, y0, y1 of the paper are left out (mathfn does not call them).
